10 Secret Santa gift ideas for pilots and aviation fans

Secret Santa works best with a clear spending limit and gifts that do not depend on detailed personal knowledge. This list favors small, neutral ideas. Treat prices as something to verify within your group’s budget, rather than assuming every aviation-branded item is affordable.

By Pilot Gift Guide · From the team behind ATC · How we choose

IN THIS GUIDEHow to chooseThe listRelated guides

How to choose

Avoid clothing sizes, technical equipment and jokes about safety or competence. If you do not know the recipient well, choose something useful or consumable. Keep the presentation friendly without implying that a novelty accessory is official equipment.

The list

Our selections prioritize personal relevance, usefulness, and fit for the recipient. Named products and destinations link to official sources where applicable.

  1. 1

    A pocket notebook

    Choose a practical size and simple cover. It can hold ordinary notes without requiring a specific flying routine.

  2. 2

    A dependable pen

    Pick something comfortable and refillable. A modest useful pen often beats a bulky novelty shaped like an aircraft.

  3. 3

    A small aviation ornament

    Choose a general aircraft design unless you know a favorite type. Consider whether the recipient celebrates the occasion the ornament represents.

  4. 4

    A luggage tag

    Use a restrained design and a sensible contact-information area. Avoid making it look like an access credential.

  5. 5

    A cable organizer

    A small pouch or simple cable ties can be useful at home or while traveling. Keep the package compact.

  6. 6

    A secondhand aviation paperback

    Check condition and choose a readable story. Avoid outdated technical instruction presented as current guidance.

  7. 7

    A favorite-style snack

    If preferences are unknown, keep dietary considerations in mind and choose sealed packaging. Do not assume everyone enjoys the same food.

  8. 8

    An aviation postcard set

    A small set can be enjoyed, displayed or sent to friends. Choose attractive images rather than a large assortment of repetitive designs.

  9. 9

    A simple aircraft keyring

    Keep it light enough for everyday use. A subtle shape is more versatile than a joke slogan.

  10. 10

    A small gift contribution within the rules

    Use a permitted gift card or contribution if your exchange allows it. Check the value and terms rather than adding an unexpected obligation.

These are editorial recommendations and planning ideas, not hands-on test results. Read our selection approach and ATC disclosure.
